# BPLA damage guide, 10 October 2026 (Moscow)

User requested a practical public article. No case materials or client information used. No previous site guide on this topic was found.

Official sources reviewed: Krasnodar MChS guidance 21.06.2026 (5763593); prosecutor explanations on victim status (e1341222), civil claim (e5876674), insurance and notification (e8450520, 06.04.2026); Bank of Russia OSAGO FAQ; MChS FAQ on essential property; Krasnodar investment portal notice 25.08.2026 on support and My Business hotline. URLs are included on the article.

Editorial boundaries: dangerous fragments must not be handled; documentation only after safe access. Distinguish insurance, public assistance and civil liability. No universal public payout, unverified compensation amount, general fixed application deadline or guaranteed recovery. Business loans are not compensation. Crime classification and liable party are not assumed. Procedural status is not a payment decision. Insurance coverage depends on the actual contract and event. Individual court decisions are not cited.
